stumbles.quote: 42/43 violations in every form and with no directive
stumbles.why: Unclear what the violations are (violations of what rule?), what 42/43 counts (trials? prompts?), and what 'every form' means. 'No directive' conflicts with 'CAPS made no difference' unless you know a baseline was tested.

stumbles.quote: Naming a forbidden word raised its log-odds ~2.5.
stumbles.why: The reader doesn't know the task: what forbidden word, forbidden by what, or the log-odds of what (the model producing it). The scale of 2.5 and the units are also unclear.

stumbles.quote: Its 22,100-doc corpus has one CAPS instruction
stumbles.why: 'Its' presumably means the model's training corpus, but this isn't stated. The link between the corpus and the behavior is left implicit.
The model is never explained. 321M presumably means parameters, but this isn't said, and the reader doesn't know it's a small model.

point: ALL-CAPS emphasis did nothing to curb forbidden-word use in a tiny model, and naming the word made it more likely, possibly because its training corpus almost never contains CAPS instructions.
